To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a brother and a sister with RTT had de novo deletions of different sizes and different positions within the gene; 2) the deletion in the brother included only a part of exon 3, whereas the one in the sister included exons 3-4; 3) the brother had milder symptoms than the sister.

(i) the non shared de novo deletions in the two sib pairs with RTT provides important insights into disease etiology; (ii) the distinct deletions in a sib pair with RTT provide important clues into the disease etiopathogenesis; (iii) the de novo deletions are a common cause of RTT.
